targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.symbol,s.period_seconds) s.* FROM pullback_signals s JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=s.symbol AND a.active WHERE s.setup_version LIKE 'pullback-1-%' ORDER BY s.symbol,s.period_seconds,s.candle_epoch DESC), valid AS (SELECT s.*,r.state FROM latest s JOIN pullback_registry r ON r.symbol=s.symbol AND r.period_seconds=s.period_seconds AND r.setup_version=s.setup_version WHERE r.state IN ('piloto','ativo') AND s.reason='setup_confirmado' AND s.side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND s.candle_epoch=(extract(epoch from now())::bigint/s.period_seconds)*s.period_seconds-s.period_seconds) SELECT symbol AS ativo,CASE period_seconds WHEN 900 THEN 'M15' WHEN 3600 THEN 'H1' ELSE 'D1' END AS periodo,side AS sinal,upper(state) AS estado,setup_version AS versao,to_timestamp(candle_epoch+period_seconds) AS vela_fechada FROM valid ORDER BY symbol,period_seconds

SELECT r.symbol AS ativo,CASE r.period_seconds WHEN 900 THEN 'M15' WHEN 3600 THEN 'H1' ELSE 'D1' END AS periodo,r.setup_version AS versao,upper(r.state) AS estado,coalesce(e.purchased,0) AS compras_demo,coalesce(e.settled,0) AS liquidadas_demo,round(e.lower_95::numeric,4) AS limite_95,coalesce(e.wins,0) AS wins_demo,CASE WHEN e.settled >= 200 THEN round(((e.wins+0.5)/(e.settled+1.0))::numeric,4) END AS prob_empirica FROM pullback_registry r JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=r.symbol AND a.active LEFT JOIN pullback_broker_status e ON e.symbol=r.symbol AND e.period_seconds=r.period_seconds AND e.setup_version=r.setup_version WHERE r.setup_version LIKE 'pullback-1-%' ORDER BY r.symbol,r.period_seconds

SELECT observed_at AS horario,symbol AS ativo,period_seconds AS periodo,side AS lado,model_version AS versao,round(quote_price::numeric,2) AS preco,round(quote_payout::numeric,2) AS pagamento,round(quote_ev::numeric,4) AS ev_real,cohort AS grupo FROM indicator_quote_observations WHERE model_version LIKE 'pullback-1-%' AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT to_timestamp(date_start) AS horario,symbol AS ativo,indicator_period_seconds AS periodo,direction AS lado,indicator_model_version AS versao,account_mode AS conta,contract_id,round(buy_price::numeric,2) AS stake,round(profit::numeric,2) AS resultado,settlement_source AS fonte FROM contract_executions WHERE indicator_model_version LIKE 'pullback-1-%' AND settlement_source IN ('broker', 'profit_table') AND $__unixEpochFilter(date_start) ORDER BY date_start DESC LIMIT 100
